name: proto-blocks/oit-page-header
title: OIT Page Header
description: Section-page header card with breadcrumb, headline, subtitle, optional CTAs, a giant background wordmark, and a scroll-triggered reveal. Dark or light theme, with circuit Lottie or icon-badge decoration on the right.

icon.label: Icon (used when icon-badge decoration is on)

wordmark.label: Background Wordmark
wordmark.help: Giant uppercase word that sits behind the card. Leave empty to hide.

highlightWord.label: Highlight word/phrase in title
highlightWord.help: First occurrence of this word or phrase in the title gets wrapped in a red span. Case-insensitive. Leave empty for no highlight.

showIconBadge.label: Show icon badge instead of circuit
